prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: preview-only environment prop concept for Survival Arena monastery gardens, not an approved runtime sprite. Create exactly ONE isolated object. Style: flat hand-drawn stylized storybook paper cutout, chunky readable silhouette, thick slightly irregular dark plum outlines (#241B2B), thinner interior lines, 2-3 large matte color masses, simple cel shading with one shadow mass, subtle sparse dry-brush texture. Orthographic 3/4 top-down view showing upper and front surfaces, neutral warm front/top lighting. Church palette: aged ivory blue-grey stone, tarnished restrained brass, small pale blue or amber accent, tiny moss patches. Very clean genuinely transparent background; ample padding all around. No background scene, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, frame, UI, photorealism, 3D render, plastic shine, pixel art, baked cast shadow, particles, ground aura, motion blur or tiny busy ornament. Keep details readable at approximately 120-180 pixels object height. Subject: a SHRINE, a low wide stone altar pedestal with two broad shallow steps and a central rectangular altar block. On top sits a compact brass reliquary framing a warm amber gem; two short chunky cream candles stand on either side. Large carved abstract sun motif on the front, simple thick brass edging, slightly chipped old stone with a tiny moss patch near one step. Quiet dignified fairy-tale monastery garden shrine. Dominant squat horizontal silhouette: overall width approximately 1.35 times height, no tall staff, column or spire. The reliquary is the clear focus. Candles unlit, gem light matte fill, no baked glow, external effects or ground ring. Entire shrine and all steps fully visible. Content context: dev-only shrine visual exploration from DECISION-0135; role environment prop.
